name: 62294 · Troy, IL
findings: ZIP 62294 (Troy) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62294 (Troy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62294 (Troy) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62294 (Troy) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
